description: Governed exit for scripts/check-producer-consumers.py (consumer-existence gate, UNWIRED-WORK/A1). Every entry MUST carry a non-empty 'reason' naming who or what consumes the producer out-of-tree, or why it is intentionally consumer-less. Patterns are fnmatch globs matched against the producer key (collection:<name>, agent:<module>, surface:<slug>) or the producer file path. Consumer-side exits additionally require kind=consumer_side and match <finding>:<read pattern>. Recheck with uv run python scripts/check-producer-consumers.py --consumer-side --allowlist /dev/null --report-json <path>. /dev/null disables every exemption because load_allowlist returns an empty list for a non-regular file. Worked key example: finding consumer-reads-unwritten-artifact plus read pattern artifacts/old.json produces consumer-reads-unwritten-artifact:artifacts/old.json (constructed as f"{kind}:{pattern}" in analyse_consumer_side). Absence in an incomplete report establishes nothing. Decay entries need their original --frame/--mass inputs.
